events.dateNote: Sunday afternoon session, 2:20–3:30 pm; NSE closed Tue 10 Nov
events.outcome: Nifty slipped 6.65 points to 25,023.70 and Sensex 28.62 to 80,999.40: the first red Muhurat close since 2017; pharma led, M&M and Infosys lagged.
events.title: Diwali Muhurat trading
events.watch: Festive retail and auto sales numbers.
events.why: A one-hour symbolic session; festive demand data around it shapes consumer stocks.

events.dateNote: 01:30 UTC (7:00 am IST)
events.outcome: CPI +0.7% y/y (0.8% expected), core 0.8%; PPI +5.7% (5.3% expected), up from 5%.
events.title: China CPI and PPI for October
events.why: Chinese factory prices drive metals, a read-across for Tata Steel and Hindalco.

events.dateNote: After the US close
events.outcome: Revenue rose 168% to $3.66bn, 2026 guidance raised to $13.0–13.3bn; the stock jumped 24.7% on 11 Nov.
events.title: CoreWeave Q3 results
events.why: First AI-cloud results since last week's chip rout.

events.outcome: Kalyan Jewellers' profit rose 64% (stock hit the 10% upper circuit); MRF's fell 26.6% on costs; Cochin Shipyard's halved; Titagarh's rose 71%.
events.title: Kalyan Jewellers, MRF, Cochin Shipyard and Titagarh Rail Q2 FY27 results
events.watch: Kalyan's same-store sales growth and margins
events.why: Kalyan gives the first post-Diwali read on jewellery demand after Titan's rally.

events.dateNote: 8:30 am ET (7:00 pm IST); NSE closed that day
events.outcome: Headline CPI +0.4% m/m (0.3% expected), core +0.3% (0.2%); the 10-year rose to about 5% and December hike odds near 85–100%.
events.title: US CPI inflation for October
events.why: After strong payrolls, a hot print would lock in a December Fed hike.

events.outcome: Tata Power's profit rose 48.6% to ₹1,366 crore and revenue 26%; Hindustan Copper's profit nearly tripled; GRSE's rose 12%.
events.title: Tata Power, Hindustan Copper and Garden Reach Shipbuilders Q2 FY27 results
events.watch: Tata Power profit growth and solar manufacturing margins
events.why: Tata Power's renewables and distribution growth set the tone for utilities.

events.dateNote: After the US close (early 13 Nov IST)
events.outcome: Cisco revenue $18.52bn (+24%), FY27 guide raised, shares about +5% after hours; Applied Materials revenue $10.41bn (+53%), next quarter guided near $11.1bn; Cerebras +13% after hours.
events.title: Cisco, Applied Materials and Cerebras results
events.why: The first big AI-hardware results after the chip rout and before Nvidia.

events.outcome: HAL profit +16% to ₹1,936 cr; Vodafone Idea loss widened to ₹5,975 cr; Hitachi Energy revenue +64%; Oil India profit +62%; Alkem profit −12%.
events.title: HAL, Vodafone Idea, Hitachi Energy, Oil India, Alkem and NMDC Q2 FY27 results
events.watch: HAL's margins, Vi's ARPU and Hitachi Energy's order inflow
events.why: Defence, telecom and power-equipment results in one day.

events.dateNote: MoSPI's usual mid-month release; not confirmed
events.outcome: 6.09% (from 5.54%), a 24-month high above the RBI's 6% ceiling; food inflation 8.94%.
events.title: India CPI inflation for October
events.why: Oil near $105–115 in October and a weak rupee feed into inflation ahead of the December RBI meeting; Brent near $98 still weighs on November.

events.outcome: Tata Motors PV lost ₹5,531 cr with JLR guidance cut to a 2–3% margin; Eicher profit +15%, ABB India +8%, Grasim swung to a ₹234 cr loss.
events.title: Eicher Motors, ABB India, Tata Motors PV and Grasim Q2 FY27 results
events.watch: TMPV's EV margins, ABB's order book, Eicher's Royal Enfield margins
events.why: Autos and capital goods close the results season.

events.dateNote: 8:30 am ET (7:00 pm IST)
events.outcome: PPI +0.3% m/m (0.4% expected) but +6.5% y/y, the most since Nov 2022; 10-year rose to about 5.15%.
events.title: US PPI for October
events.why: Confirms or softens Tuesday's CPI read before the December Fed meeting.

events.dateNote: Before the US open, per earnings calendars
events.title: Baidu and XPeng results
events.watch: Baidu EPS vs $0.57 consensus; AI-cloud growth
events.why: Opens the China tech results week ahead of PDD and Alibaba.

events.dateNote: 8:50 am JST (5:20 am IST), per the Cabinet Office schedule
events.title: Japan GDP for July–September (first estimate)
events.watch: Annualised growth vs Dai-ichi Life's 0.4% forecast
events.why: A weak print would weigh on the yen and Asian sentiment at Monday's open.

events.dateNote: Nvidia confirmed 17 Nov after the US close (about 2:50 am IST on 18 Nov); first results under interim CEO Colette Kress.
events.title: Nvidia fiscal Q3 results
events.why: The main read on AI accelerator demand, now overshadowed by a report that Nvidia's board may oust CEO Jensen Huang.

events.dateNote: 8:30 am ET (7:00 pm IST), per Schwab's weekly calendar
events.title: US retail sales and industrial production for October
events.why: A strong consumer would cement a December hike and push yields higher.

events.dateNote: Pricing reported for 18 Nov, trading from 19 Nov; not officially confirmed
events.title: Anthropic IPO pricing ($70–78 range)
events.why: Up to $64.4bn raised would be the largest listing on record; the book is reported about six times covered.

events.dateNote: Opens 18 Nov, closes 20 Nov, per Zee Business
events.title: Crystal Crop Protection IPO (₹455 crore, ₹259–272)
events.why: First mainboard IPO in over two weeks; a read on appetite for new listings.

events.dateNote: 2:00 pm ET (12:30 am IST on 19 Nov)
events.title: FOMC minutes from the October meeting
events.why: Shows how many officials want a bigger or longer hiking path.

events.dateNote: Per company disclosure reported by Business Standard
events.title: SpiceJet board meets on a fresh capital raise
events.why: The size of the raise decides whether the airline can keep flying its fleet.

events.dateNote: Before the US open, per Schwab's weekly calendar
events.title: Walmart and Alibaba results
events.why: Read on the US consumer under 6%-plus inflation and on China demand.

events.title: NSE holiday: Guru Nanak Jayanti
events.why: No Indian trading; global moves gap into the next session.

events.dateNote: Usually the last working day of November; one report says 30 Nov. Not confirmed.
events.title: India GDP for July–September
events.watch: Real GDP vs nowcasts of 7.35% (finance ministry) and 7.8% (SBI Research)
events.why: Shows how much the oil shock and weak rupee have hit growth.

events.dateNote: Ministerial meeting of all 21 OPEC+ members, per Reuters (1 Nov)
events.title: OPEC+ ministerial meeting on 2027 production framework
events.watch: Any change to 2027 quotas or the remaining ~2 million b/d cut layer
events.why: Sets 2027 baselines after Brent swung from $117 to $94 and back near $98 in a week.

events.dateNote: MPC meets 2–4 Dec; decision expected on the last day
events.title: RBI monetary policy decision
events.why: The RBI balances rupee defence and oil-driven inflation against slowing growth.

events.dateNote: Expected 8–9 Dec per the Fed's 2026 schedule; not re-confirmed by the desk
events.title: Federal Reserve rate decision
events.watch: Fed funds target and the dot plot
events.why: Markets price about a 70% chance of a hike after oil-driven inflation; a hike would pressure EM currencies and flows.
